Run `npm run setup:ai` once to download Stockfish.js 19.0.1 lite single-threaded
worker, WebAssembly and GPL license into this folder. The browser loads these
files locally only when a computer turn starts. Local two-player needs none of
these engine assets. `npm run build` includes them when installed.

Upstream source and build instructions: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js
Pinned distribution: https://www.npmjs.com/package/stockfish/v/19.0.1
